$Comment: Santa, Christmas's host, alone in a group of one. The reputation group Christmas_Nice_List (NPC/Reputation/Groups) names this group, which is how the game ties the way Santa treats each player to that player's place on his Nice List. Add another role id to IncludeRoles, written *<id>, and that character shares Santa's list. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role, while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
